subject: RE: Database Migration — Approved
body:
Hi Diana,

Reviewed docs/database-migration-plan.md and NEX-189. Approved from my side as CTO, with conditions:
1. Keep the logical replication standby live for 72 hours (not 48).
2. Confirm on-call is briefed for the full window.
3. Company-wide maintenance notice 48h ahead.

Green light for November 3.

Raj Patel, CTO
